name: WhiteWolf
identity: Original low robust shaggy WOLF: white/ivory upper fur and cheek ruff, large warm-gray coat regions and broad ochre round patches, golden eyes, upright pointed ears with ochre inner pads, long narrow muzzle, ivory fangs, jagged white back ruff, four short gray/white paws, and a LONG BUSHY curved gray tail with a white outer stripe and tip. NO collar or equipment.

anatomy_observations.ears: Two tall upright pointed wolf ears, pale outer fur, ochre inner pads visible only from front.
anatomy_observations.head: Long muzzle and pointed cheek ruff; frontal normal has stern golden eyes and ivory fangs, angry opens the long jaw, dead has closed eyes and a slack ochre tongue. No collar.
anatomy_observations.body: Low robust warm-gray torso, broad round ochre patches and jagged white dorsal fur; no horns, armor or actual dorsal spines.
anatomy_observations.feet: Exactly four short paws: straight foreleg and bent hock hindleg. Rear feet show heel/hock surfaces, without front toe stripes or claws.
anatomy_observations.tail: Long curved bushy gray/white wolf tail. Detached root at TOP CENTER, tail extends DOWN to a swept pointed white tip. Root hidden under rump; pivots explicitly revised to root, not default bottom.
anatomy_observations.rear: Faceless white/gray back of wolf head, outer pointed ears and rear neck fur. No golden eyes, inner ear pads, muzzle, fangs or facial marks. Same head in all three Up states.
anatomy_observations.connections: Opaque neck overlaps torso, shoulder and hip caps extend under torso; four paws remain distinct. Long tail attaches to rump with root concealed.
anatomy_observations.native_contract: Wolf Ready/Walk/Attack 0.5s, Death 0.416666657s. Preserve source float/PPtr keys, original SetHead and Attack events, duration and loop flags.
